subject: Lighting and power for productive work
hook: Fitted home office desks planned around your sockets and light.
gbp:
Working from home more this year? SUPERIO designs and builds fitted home office furniture around the room you have, including where your sockets, switches and windows already sit.

It suits box rooms, spare bedrooms, loft rooms and alcoves where a freestanding desk never quite fits or leaves cables trailing across the floor.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation
- Measuring, with every socket and switch recorded
- Desk, storage and shelving planned with grommets, cable trays and access cut-outs
- An itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves
- Delivery and installation by our own team

We work across Stoke-on-Trent, Newcastle-under-Lyme and the surrounding area. If you need extra sockets, a qualified electrician can add them before installation and we'll advise where they're most useful.

Tap Learn more to see our home office furniture and arrange your consultation.
